svg.text: GPU staging occupancy | ShareGPT cold + 4 warm replays
Qwen3-14B | DRAM 512 GiB | staging 8 GiB | concurrency 16 | 1,684 requests per phase
100% = 8 GiB. Blue: sampled maximum per 2-second bin. Green: sampled mean.

svg.text: X = seconds since each phase began (each panel has its own duration); Y = staging occupancy (%).
20 ms samples can miss brief peaks. Event peaks above use allocation events, not the sampled line.
Includes read and write buffers; NOT GPU compute utilization. Warm phases retain the same live cache.
